name: Syrups (maple, agave, molasses)

iAs.label: Inorganic arsenic is a component of total arsenic (iAs <= tAs). The iAs value (500 ug/kg) is not below the binding total arsenic ceiling (100 ug/kg), so inorganic arsenic is governed by and bounded by the total arsenic ceiling; no separate iAs ceiling is published. It is enforced by reflex speciation whenever tAs is elevated.

MeHg.rationale: No methylation pathway and no mercury source in a sugar syrup. Total mercury is governed (50, Vietnam).

Ni.rationale: No sovereign nickel ML exists for syrups, but molasses concentrates minerals (including nickel) during repeated sugar extraction, so a real concentration pathway exists. Held under a reflex screen rather than declared not-material.
Ni.reference_method: Total nickel by ICP-MS on each lot; molasses monitored under ALARA against the tightest available food nickel context.

Cr.rationale: No sovereign total-chromium ML exists for any sweetener (the only food total-Cr MLs in the register are dairy), so there is no number to publish. But the not-material 'no chromium pathway' claim is factually wrong for the molasses member of this combined maple/agave/molasses cell: molasses is a documented chromium concentrate (reported total Cr ~0.27 mg/kg, the highest-Cr sweetener, molasses >> refined white sugar), produced by the same repeated sugar-extraction mineral-concentration pathway that already holds nickel under control in this exact cell. Total chromium is therefore held under a mandatory ICP-MS screen under ALARA rather than declared not-material, with Cr-VI remaining the reflex-speciation control. Rebuttable and audited against the register each build.
Cr.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS on each lot under ALARA; reflex Cr(VI) speciation (IC-ICP-MS) on any elevated total-Cr screen.

Cr-VI.rationale: Hexavalent chromium is never a panel number for a food; it is the reflex-speciation species. Any total-chromium exceedance is speciated, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails.
Cr-VI.reference_method: IC-ICP-MS Cr(VI) speciation (EPA 3060A + EPA 6800 / EN 15192) on any total-Cr exceedance.

Sn.rationale: Tin migrates only from tinplate cans; these syrups are sold in glass/plastic, not tinplate. No non-canned tin pathway exists.

Al.rationale: No sovereign aluminium ML exists for syrups and no aluminium pathway operates. Rebuttable and audited each build.

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default; face value, no reconstitution; read-across / control / not-material for unregulated cells; no occurrence percentiles)
lineage_note: Syrups are treated as sugars: the strictest sovereign sugar/syrup ML governs (Pb/tAs 100 MERCOSUR-Paraguay 'sugars'; Cd 150 / iAs-controlled Israel 'Sugar'; tHg 50 Vietnam 'Sugar'). Two feasibility flags for staff, NOT resolved here: (1) maple syrup carries a documented lead pathway from legacy lead-soldered evaporators and tapping hardware, so the strict Pb 100 is protective and appropriate; (2) molasses concentrates minerals and lead during sugar extraction and may not meet Pb 100 without clean sourcing — a feasibility-driven transition, not a reason to loosen the government-anchored ceiling.
